cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put our plates together. We'll have dinner side by side tonight, even though I missed your opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left that seat empty. You can have an empty one tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I earned that. I'll move the food over to your end instead; you needn't move. But let me sit beside you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm still going to tell you everything you missed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, we'll start there. I'll serve while you tell it, and I won't defend myself between scenes. Keep your plate where it is; just leave me the next chair.

reason: Give A a seating plan revised to B space and storytelling conditions, preserving the effort to end retaliatory distance without declaring forgiveness.
